description: Source code implementing URL normalization, matching, and configuration handling functions for URL pattern matching within a project.

methods.name: append_normalized_escapes
methods.description: Appends characters from a string to a buffer, escaping or unescaping based on URL encoding rules.

methods.name: end_of_token
methods.description: Finds the end of a token in a string based on a delimiter character.

methods.name: match_host
methods.description: Compares host components of URL info structures, supporting wildcards.

methods.name: url_normalize_1
methods.description: Performs detailed URL normalization including case conversion, escaping, path resolution, and port removal.

methods.name: url_normalize
methods.description: Simplified URL normalization function calling url_normalize_1.

methods.name: url_match_prefix
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches a prefix, considering implicit slashes.

methods.name: match_urls
methods.description: Checks if a URL matches a URL pattern, including scheme, host, port, and path.

methods.name: cmp_matches
methods.description: Compares two URL match items based on host, path, and user match quality.

methods.name: urlmatch_config_entry
methods.description: Processes configuration entries for URL matching rules, normalizing URLs and storing match info.

methods.name: urlmatch_config_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with URL match configuration.
